pace_note: User, Oct 14: there is no separate first-email cap. First emails (S1) always go first; follow-ups fill whatever room is left and slide to the next day when the 60-a-day total is reached. The 60-a-day total is shared with ASI's mailbox.

cross_business_conflict.note: Before any draft: check the company against ASI's master list, trade list and do_not_contact.csv (one company, one sequence across both businesses), and check the site's address and RN against ASI hook packets and samples.

footer.text: If this isn't useful, reply "no thanks" and I won't email again.
